const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Interactive, vision-guided controller for the current handle-press episode.
+
+Commands are read from stdin so the same Robot client stays connected while I
+inspect each returned camera view: approach, inspect, descend, press <metres>,
+hold, or quit.  ee_delta is issued one native control step per row.
+"""
+import json
+import math
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
+CAMERAS = ['front', 'left', 'right', 'topview']
+TARGET = np.array([-0.09669447289429418, 0.6653270239200273, 0.07582551115455544])
+DT = 0.0125
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+
+def observe(tag):
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video='frames')
+    stamp = f'{tag}_{int(time.time())}'
+    for cam, img in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(img).save(OUT / f'{stamp}_{cam}.png')
+    for cam, arr in obs.depth.items():
+        np.save(OUT / f'{stamp}_depth_{cam}.npy', arr)
+    print(json.dumps({'meta': obs.meta, 'proprio': obs.meta.get('proprio', {}).get('now'),
+                      'saved': stamp}, separators=(',', ':')), flush=True)
+    return obs
+
+def current():
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=['front'], video='frames')
+    return np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+
+def move_to(xyz, grip=-1.0, note='move_to'):
+    p = current()
+    start = p[4:7]
+    delta = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float) - start
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) * 100.0)))
+    row = np.r_[delta * (100.0 / n), grip]
+    if np.max(np.abs(row[:3])) > 1.000001:
+        raise ValueError('requested move exceeds per-step action limits')
+    a = np.repeat(row[None, :], n, axis=0)
+    res = r.submit('ee_delta', a, dt=DT, cameras=CAMERAS, video='mp4', note=note)
+    print(json.dumps({'move': note, 'steps': n, 'start_mocap': start.tolist(),
+                      'requested_mocap': list(map(float, xyz)), 'action_row': row.tolist(),
+                      'done': res.meta.get('done'), 'reason': res.meta.get('reason'),
+                      'control_steps': res.meta.get('control_steps'), 'time_left_s': res.meta.get('time_left_s')},
+                     separators=(',', ':')), flush=True)
+    observe(note)
+
+def relative_press(dz, grip=-1.0):
+    p = current()
+    start = p[4:7]
+    move_to([start[0], start[1], start[2] + float(dz)], grip=grip, note='press')
+
+print(json.dumps({'spec': spec, 'target_pos': TARGET.tolist()}, separators=(',', ':')), flush=True)
+observe('initial')
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    words = line.strip().split()
+    if not words:
+        continue
+    cmd = words[0].lower()
+    try:
+        if cmd == 'approach':
+            move_to([TARGET[0], TARGET[1], 0.26], note='approach')
+        elif cmd == 'inspect':
+            observe('inspect')
+        elif cmd == 'descend':
+            move_to([TARGET[0], TARGET[1], 0.20], note='descend')
+        elif cmd == 'press' and len(words) > 1:
+            relative_press(float(words[1]))
+        elif cmd == 'move' and len(words) == 4:
+            move_to(list(map(float, words[1:])), note='manual_move')
+        elif cmd == 'hold':
+            seconds = float(words[1]) if len(words) > 1 else 1.0
+            obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, seconds=seconds, include_depth=True, video='mp4')
+            print(json.dumps({'hold_s': seconds, 'meta': obs.meta,
+                              'proprio': obs.meta.get('proprio', {}).get('now')}, separators=(',', ':')), flush=True)
+        elif cmd in ('quit', 'exit'):
+            break
+        else:
+            print('commands: approach | inspect | descend | press <dz> | move <x> <y> <z> | hold [seconds] | quit', flush=True)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(json.dumps({'error': repr(e)}, separators=(',', ':')), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
const result = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
